Customer Service: Excellent communication, empathy and problem-solving skills.
Event Coordination: Strong organizational abilities with experience managing multi-stakeholder logistics.

paragraphs: I am writing to apply for the Sin experiencia / Remoto / Atención al cliente position at GEA Perú. The opportunity to work in a customer-centric role within a globally recognized company is exactly what I have been seeking — and my background makes me an ideal fit.

With experience in coordinating large-scale events, managing logistics, and liaising with multiple stakeholders, I am confident that my organizational skills and ability to communicate effectively will be valuable assets to the GEA Perú customer service team. My internships at International House Oulu have honed these abilities, as well as my capacity for multitasking and problem-solving.

I am currently pursuing Finnish supplementary law studies at the University of Lapland (OPH-recognised), which demonstrates my commitment to integrating my international expertise with local practices. This, combined with my legal research experience in India, positions me uniquely to contribute to GEA Perú's diverse workforce.

GEA Perú's reputation for providing excellent customer service and support aligns perfectly with my own values and aspirations. I am excited about the prospect of joining your team and contributing to its ongoing success.
Thank you for considering my application. I look forward to the opportunity to discuss further how my skills and experience can benefit GEA Perú.
